title: Consumers and Retailers Prepare for Small Business Saturday on Nov. 28, 2026

facts.fact: Small Business Saturday in 2026 falls on Saturday, November 28, 2026, the Saturday following Thanksgiving.
facts.quote: will take place this year on Saturday, November 28, 2026

facts.fact: Small Business Saturday was founded by American Express in 2010.
facts.quote: Founded by American Express in 2010, and officially co-sponsored by the

facts.fact: The article states the Small Business Saturday movement supports more than 36.2 million independent businesses nationwide.
facts.quote: the movement supports more than 36.2 million independent businesses nationwide

facts.fact: The article states Small Business Saturday has driven over $100 billion in cumulative local spending since 2021.
facts.quote: has driven over $100 billion in cumulative local spending since 2021

facts.fact: The article states shoppers spent an estimated $18 billion to $22 billion during recent single-day Small Business Saturday events.
facts.quote: shoppers spending an estimated $18 billion to $22 billion during recent single-day events

facts.fact: Any independent brick-and-mortar or online business can participate in Small Business Saturday for free.
facts.quote: Any independent brick-and-mortar or online business can participate for free.

facts.fact: Participating businesses do not need to pay or officially register just to run a promotion, but listing on the official Shop Small map has a 25-location cap.
facts.quote: listing on the official Shop Small map has specific rules, such as a 25-location cap

facts.fact: Local business groups and chambers of commerce can receive complimentary Shop Small merchandise kits through the American Express Neighborhood Champion program.
facts.quote: receiving complimentary Shop Small merchandise kits through the American Express Neighborhood Champion program

facts.fact: Small business owners can obtain free Small Business Saturday marketing materials from American Express.
facts.quote: Small businesses owners can obtain free Small Business Saturday marketing materials
